title: 「Upon + noun ／ V-ing」表示「一……便／在……之後」

source.file: Sentence Structure 193 -「Upon + noun _ V-ing」表示「一……便／在……之後」.pdf
omissions: Every numbered Important Rule and Benefit is retained as a separate Chinese-primary card. Where the PDF has no English counterpart, the English explanation is a faithful editorial translation.

formula: Upon + noun phrase / V-ing, + subject + verb + other information

formulas.formula: Upon + noun phrase, + subject + verb + other information
Upon + V-ing, + subject + verb + other information
Subject + verb + other information + upon + noun phrase / V-ing

example: Upon arrival, visitors were asked to register at the front desk.
exampleZh: 抵達後，訪客被要求在前台登記。

examples.en: Upon arrival, visitors were asked to register at the front desk.
examples.zh: 抵達後，訪客被要求在前台登記。
examples.highlight: Upon arrival, visitors were asked to register at the front desk.

meaning.zh: 本課練習目標句型：Upon + noun phrase / V-ing, + subject + verb + other information。

rules.zh: Upon 表示某事發生時，另一件事隨即或很快發生 Upon 的意思接近 when、after 或 as soon as，但通常更強調前一件事發生後，另一件事隨即發 生。
rules.en: Upon shows that when one event occurs, another happens immediately or very soon afterwards. It is close in meaning to when, after or as soon as, but it often gives a stronger sense of immediate sequence.
examples: It is close in meaning to when, after or as soon as, but it often gives a stronger sense of

rules.zh: Upon 後面接名詞或 V-ing，不接完整句子 正確： 錯誤：
rules.en: Follow upon with a noun or V-ing form, not a complete clause. Correct: Upon arrival, ...; Upon receiving the email, .... Incorrect: Upon she arrived, ...; Upon to receive the email, ....

rules.zh: 使用 Upon + V-ing 時，V-ing 的動作者通常必須與主句主語相同 進入房間和開燈的人都是 Leo。
rules.en: With upon + V-ing, the doer of the -ing action must normally be the subject of the main clause. In “Upon entering the room, Leo switched on the light”, Leo both enters the room and switches on the light.
examples: Upon entering the room, Leo switched on the light.

rules.zh: Upon 短語放在句首時，後面通常加逗號 如 Upon 短語放在主句後面，通常不需要逗號：
rules.en: When an upon phrase comes first, normally put a comma after it: Upon completion of the task, please inform your teacher. When it follows the main clause, a comma is normally unnecessary: Please inform your teacher upon completion of the task.
examples: Upon completion of the task, please inform your teacher.
Please inform your teacher upon completion of the task.

rules.zh: Upon 比 when 或 after 較正式 Upon 特別常見於通告、指示、程序、報告及專業寫作。
rules.en: Upon is more formal than when or after. It is especially common in notices, instructions, procedures, reports and professional writing.
examples: It is especially common in notices, instructions, procedures, reports and professional writing.

rules.zh: 較高階的被動形式是 Upon being + past participle （乘客獲悉延誤後，便更改了計劃。）
rules.en: A more advanced passive form is upon being + past participle: Upon being informed of the delay, the passengers changed their plans.
examples: Upon being informed of the delay, the passengers changed their plans.

benefits.zh: 清楚顯示事情發生的先後次序 讀者可以立即看出哪件事先發生，以及之後隨即發生甚麼事。
benefits.en: It makes the order of events clear The reader can immediately see which event happened first and what followed.

benefits.zh: 縮短較長的時間子句 你可以用較短的 Upon arrival，代替較長的 As soon as visitors arrived。
benefits.en: It can shorten a longer time clause Instead of saying As soon as visitors arrived, you can say Upon arrival.

benefits.zh: 適合用於指示和程序 這個句型可以清楚說明某個步驟完成後，有關人士應該做甚麼。
benefits.en: It is useful for instructions and procedures The structure helps you explain what someone should do at a particular stage.

benefits.zh: 令文字更精確和專業 它適合用於電郵、通告、報告、規則及工作文件。
benefits.en: It gives writing a precise and professional tone It is useful in emails, notices, reports, rules and workplace documents.

benefits.zh: 增加句式變化 以 Upon 開始句子，可以避免反覆使用 When 或 After，令寫作不會過於單調。 Compare 比較 （系統一收到付款，便會發送確認電郵。） 第二句較簡潔，亦更適合正式通知或工作程序。
benefits.en: It gives you another way to begin a sentence. Beginning with Upon creates sentence variety and avoids repeatedly starting with When or After. Compare: As soon as payment is received, our system sends a confirmation email. Our system sends a confirmation email upon receipt of payment. The second sentence is more concise and better suited to a formal notice or workplace procedure.
